skills.desc:
Earth type piercing attack on all enemies (XL)
* When skill is used, user will be inflicted with "Prevent Action" which will make her unable to move next turn.
* If Tron is at 3 stacks, above effect is cancelled and all stacks are consumed.
** When used during Another Force at 3 stacks, Tron will be consumed & can continuously use Annihilate without getting "Prevent Action" status.
